copper-alloy radiate of Carausius dating to the period AD 286-293 (Reece Period 14). [LEG X?]X AVG, Boar standing left. C Mint, - //MC. This coin is unpublished, but the British Museum has a similar piece with the legend LEG XX AVG, Boar left, but with the mintmark - // SNC (British Museum 1920 0618 3A).
